title: VU#644655: TightVNC and UltraVNC Viewer contains a heap-based buffer overflow
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Tight JPEG decoding component of TightVNC Windows Viewer 1.3.10 and affected UltraVNC Windows Viewers. A malicious VNC server can send a specially crafted screen update that triggers memory corruption by overflowing a heap buffer during JPEG decompression. This can crash the viewer and interrupt remote desktop sessions. Although arbitrary code execution is possible in theory, only denial of service was demonstrated during testing. UltraVNC has fixed this issue in version 1.8.2.8 and later. TightVNC has not provided a fix, so users should replace affected viewers or restrict connections to trusted servers.
